map.万只鸡一周生产核算: Production accounting for 10,000 hens over a week
map.存栏 10000 只，7 天共产蛋 63000 枚、耗料 8400 kg，平均蛋: 10,000 hens, 63,000 eggs and 8,400 kg feed in 7 days, average egg 58 g. Hen-days = 10,000×7 = 70,000, lay rate = 63,000÷70,000 = 90.00%; total egg weight = 63,000×58÷1000 = 3,654 kg, feed-egg ratio = 8,400÷3,654 = 2.30, within the peak-range norm.
map.产蛋率维持 90% 不变，但料蛋比由 2.15 升到 2.40。先排查的是耗料端: Lay rate stays 90% but feed-egg ratio rises from 2.15 to 2.40. First check the feed side (spillage, trough adjustment, rodents), then whether average egg weight dropped and shrank total weight; when lay rate is flat but the ratio rises, feed use is usually overstated.
map.只日耗料 117.5 g/只·日、只日产蛋重 52.8 g，二者之比约为 2.2: Per-bird daily feed 117.5 g/bird·day and daily egg weight 52.8 g give a ratio of about 2.23, matching the flock feed-egg ratio, so the entered weights are self-consistent; a clear mismatch usually means the average egg weight was a sample value rather than the whole-flock weigh.
map.产蛋率为什么按饲养日算？: Why use hen-days for lay rate?
map.饲养日产蛋率的分母是存栏鸡数乘以统计天数，能同时反映死淘与减产，比「产蛋数÷存栏: Hen-day lay rate uses hens × days as the denominator, reflecting both mortality and production drops, closer to reality than eggs÷hens; the difference is especially clear across months.
map.料蛋比多少算合理？: What is a reasonable feed-egg ratio?
map.商品蛋鸡高峰期通常在 2.0~2.4，超过 2.5 需要检查饲料浪费、蛋重下降或: Commercial layers at peak are usually 2.0–2.4; above 2.5 check feed waste, egg-weight drop or flock health. The ratio rises naturally with age; judge against the same-age standard curve, not the absolute value.
map.平均蛋重该怎么取？: How should average egg weight be taken?
map.建议按日抽称 30~50 枚或全群称量后取平均，短期用固定值（如 58 g）也可: Weigh 30–50 eggs daily or weigh the whole flock and average; a fixed value (e.g., 58 g) is fine short-term, but egg-weight changes amplify ratio swings, so measure weekly when comparing across weeks.
